title: OneDeploy PCI device rules
description: Validates the value of pci_devices for one inventory host. Rules are evaluated in list order. An empty list disables device configuration.

vendor.description: PCI vendor ID or *. Ignored when address is supplied.

device.description: PCI device ID or *. Ignored when address is supplied.

class.description: PCI class selector. Use x for a wildcard digit or * for any class. Ignored when address is supplied.

unguarded.description: Bypass the role's guard for matching devices.

unlisted.description: Keep matching devices out of OpenNebula's PCI inventory.

virtual.description: Allow matching SR-IOV virtual devices to be absent.

set_counter.description: Reset the counter used by the {3} rename placeholder.

set_driver.description: Driver override, or omit to leave the driver alone.

set_name.description: Interface name or Python format string, or omit to leave the name alone.

set_numvfs.description: Requested SR-IOV virtual function count, or max for the device's maximum.

set_switchdev.description: Select switchdev mode when true or legacy mode when false.

set_unmanaged.description: Mark matching interfaces unmanaged by Netplan or NetworkManager.

address.description: Fully qualified PCI slot selector (domain:bus:device.function) or a six-component colon-delimited MAC address or glob.
